tuv.seg: The European Council, noting that serious forms of crime increasingly have tax and duty aspects, calls on Member States to provide full mutual legal assistance in the investigation and prosecution of this type of crime.

tuv.seg: The European Council calls for the approximation of criminal law and procedures on money laundering (in particular, confiscating funds), adding that the scope of criminal activities which constitute principal offences for money laundering should be uniform and sufficiently broad in all Member States.

Европскиот совет бара приближување на кривичното право и постапките за перење пари (особено одземањето на финансиски средства), додавајќи дека опсегот на криминалните активности, кои ги сочинуваат главните дејства против кривични дела за перење пари, треба да бидат еднообразни и доволно опсежни во сите земји членки.

tuv.seg: The European Council in Tampere considered that, with regard to national criminal law, efforts to agree on common definitions, incriminations and sanctions should be focused in the first instance on a limited number of sectors of particular relevance, such as financial crime.

tuv.seg: Reservations in respect of the 1990 Convention

tu.prop: final dry run accepted clean HIGH

tuv.seg: In order to enhance action against organised crime, Member States shall take the necessary steps not to make or uphold reservations in respect of the following articles of the 1990 Convention:

Со цел да се засили активноста против организираниот криминал, земјите членки ги преземаат потребните чекори да не прават или применуваат резервирања во врска со следните членови од Конвенцијата од 1990 година:

tu.prop: final dry run accepted clean HIGH

tuv.seg: (a) Article 2, in so far as the offence is punishable by deprivation of liberty or a detention order for a maximum of more than one year.
(а)Член 2, ако за кривичното дело се пропишува санкција лишување од слобода или наредба за притвор подолг од една година.

tu.prop: final dry run accepted clean HIGH

tuv.seg: However, Member States may uphold reservations on Article 2 of the 1990 Convention in respect of the confiscation of the proceeds from tax offences for the sole purpose of their being able to confiscate such proceeds, both nationally and through international cooperation, under national, Community and international tax-debt recovery legislation;

Сепак, земјите членки може да се придржуваат кон резервирањата од член 2 од Конвенцијата од 1990 година во врска со одземањето на приносите од даночни кривични дела со единствена цел да можат да ги одземат ваквите приноси и на национално ниво, и преку меѓународна соработка, според националното законодавство, законодавството на Заедницата и меѓународното законодавство за поврат на даночен долг;

tu.prop: final dry run accepted clean HIGH

tuv.seg: Such offences shall in any event include offences which are punishable by deprivation of liberty or a detention order for a maximum of more than one year or, as regards those States which have a minimum threshold for offences in their legal system, offences punishable by deprivation of liberty or a detention order for a minimum of more than six months.

tuv.seg: Each Member State shall take the necessary steps consistent with its system of penalties to ensure that the offences referred to in Article 6(1)(a) and (b) of the 1990 Convention, as they result from the Article 1(b) of this framework Decision, are punishable by deprivation of liberty for a maximum of not less than 4 years.

tuv.seg: By 1 March 2003, Member States shall forward to the General Secretariat of the Council and to the Commission the text of the provisions transposing into their national law the obligations arising for them from this framework Decision and, where appropriate, the notifications made pursuant to Article 40(2) of the 1990 Convention.
